family_reports.body: My custody time was decreased due to lack of investigative efforts by CPS and GAL, resulting in progressive and ongoing psychological and physical harm being inflicted upon my children.

The system has retraumatized me repeatedly, increased my disability symptoms from the extra stress and trauma to the point that I can't work, caused my children to be traumatized from the acts and behaviors of the other party. It has left me bankrupt, put me back in an unsafe situation, with my children experiencing threats of harm from the other party. DV doesn't stop when you leave, the abuser weaponizes the legal system.
